history.content: ok so this is gonna sound dumb but i saw on instagram that an old college friend got married last weekend. fully did not invite me lol. anyway im fine its whatever
That "did not invite me" bit lands with a little sting, even if you're keeping it in the "it's whatever" lane. If you want, we can just stay with that moment for a second.

ha yeah a little sting i guess. the dumb thing is i cant even be mad at her. we were super close in uni and then i just... stopped texting back. like for years. so its not like she forgot me, i kind of disappeared first
That sounds like a mix of sting and something heavier under it, maybe regret or self-blame for having disappeared first.

yeah. regret is probably the word. i tell people im just bad at keeping in touch which is true but its also a cop out. she used to be my person yknow? wed talk every day. and i let it go cause i got busy and depressed and now its just this thing i scroll past. the wedding photos were really nice though, good for her, genuinely
Regret fits, and there’s also a quieter ache in the way she used to be your person. The wedding photos being genuinely nice for her gives it a more mixed feel, not just one clean thing.

the disconnected thing yeah. honestly i think im less sad about the wedding and more just realizing how many people ive let slip without meaning to. like she was the big one but shes not the only one. somewhere along the way i just got really good at being alone and i dont totally know how that happened
That “really good at being alone” feels like it came with a cost you only noticed looking back. We can stay with that, or leave the wedding part here and just hold the wider drift for a moment.
lonely is the honest one yeah. ok i think thats enough emotional damage for one tuesday lol. thanks for this, it actually helped to just say it. gonna go make some dinner now
Glad you said it out loud. Enjoy dinner, and take the rest of Tuesday gently.
